releases.notes: Experimental hardware test: QuadSlot LB+RB hold 600ms then D-pad, boot stock and repeat slot to return stock, numbered LED/haptic feedback and Wi-Fi cues, hidden stock with 12 assignable library positions, transport-specific SignalScope, compact tuning and fictional premium Easter egg. Preserves old profile storage and custom IDs, clears old stock slot assignment. Export profiles before upgrading. Host and mock tests passed; actual rumble, switching and NVS pending. RP2040 untouched; dev15 retained.

Experimental UI and telemetry refinement: single SignalScope panel, real SSID, uptime, minimum free heap, session report count and last-report age; compact Settings, direct Update, network mode cards and About. Removed unsupported thermal/power placeholders. Profile schema and gameplay processing unchanged. RP2040 untouched. Signed build and browser/mock tests passed; hardware measurements pending. Dev14 retained for recovery.

EXPERIMENTAL hardware-test build: final Controller Studio interface, Advanced Mapping, independent tuning groups, X/Y gain and radial geometry, directional MeatVault, SignalScope measured diagnostics, Settings/MeatLink. Migrates saved profiles into schema3 and retains dev13 storage for downgrade. Export important profiles before upgrading. Signed build and host/browser tests passed; real hardware testing pending. RP2040 unchanged. Dev13 remains recovery option.

EXPERIMENTAL Hambone Studio redesign: framed application, horizontal panes, three SVG controller skins, focused tuning, portable profiles, and existing network/OTA tools. Mock browser tests and signed build passed. Physical testing pending. No gameplay processing, RP2040, Bluetooth or profile storage changes. Dev.12 is the owner-tested recovery checkpoint.

EXPERIMENTAL: shared Hambone Controller Studio, independent stick/trigger/rumble tuning layers, portable v2 profiles and graph previews. Build and simulated storage/browser tests passed; physical hardware testing pending. Retains dev.11 profile storage for downgrade.
Owner-tested installation: named profiles, dual-skin two-tap visual remapper and simple local hostname. Recovery checkpoint before Controller Studio.
Hardware-tested development build: mobile layout, saved home Wi-Fi preference with direct AP fallback, successful local OTA.
Hardware-tested recovery build: stop controller discovery after pairing; reliable AP and remapping.
